facts.claim: Tholos Resort (Imerovigli, Santorini; page title 'Wedding hotel santorini | Imerovigli Wedding | Tholos Hotel', described as a 'luxury resort') has a Weddings page offering to bring 'the wedding of your dreams to life'. Caldera view in the venue's words: 'the whitewashed suites to the harsh imposing cliff in which they nestle, the fierce beauty of the volcano as it lays half sunk in the sea, and the white villages crowning the Caldera top farther in the distance, compose a breathtaking scenery, the ideal romantic background for you to tie the knot'. It also cites sunset colours as the backdrop.

Tholos Resort's own blog says ceremony options include 'a low-key wedding at a quaint whitewashed chapel that faces the volcano, a lively wedding, a wedding on the beach or at Tholos Resort premises', and that Tholos offers wedding planning covering ceremony, decoration, photography, music and the reception menu. It proposes its Honeymoon Suite for newlyweds.
Tholos Resort's Weddings page links a Wedding Packages PDF (not read in this run). Neither the Weddings page nor the wedding blog post publishes guest capacity, room count or exclusive-use terms.

Iconic Santorini is a boutique cave hotel in Imerovigli, adults only (over 14), 'set on the rim of Santorini's volcanic cliffs' on 'a spectacular hillside setting literally carved from the historic caldera wall', across five levels; its restaurant offers dining 'while soaking in a view of the caldera of Santorini'. Its homepage does not mention weddings, and /weddings/ returned 404 on 2026-11-12. Does NOT qualify (wedding part unmet).

Cavo Tagoo Santorini's own page says it is 'Set between breathtaking Caldera views and an iconic infinity pool' and its concierge services include 'Special occasion planning'. No weddings page found (/santorini/weddings/ returned 404 on 2026-11-12). Does NOT qualify (wedding part unmet; 'special occasion planning' is not a stated wedding offer).

Secret Hotels (Oia; Santorini Secret Premium, Secret Legend Suites, View Hotel by Secret) state 'Panoramic views to the Caldera' and 'cave rooms on the Caldera'. The homepage does not mention weddings and /weddings returned 404 on 2026-11-12. Does NOT qualify (wedding part unmet).

insider_details.detail: Tholos Resort sits on the Imerovigli cliff and frames its weddings around the volcano and the white villages along the caldera rim, with sunset as the backdrop, so build the ceremony time around sunset and confirm the exact terrace in the Wedding Packages PDF.

Tholos says it can plan a chapel ceremony facing the volcano, a beach wedding or one on its own premises, so couples can split the ceremony off-site and keep the reception at the hotel; transfers between chapel and hotel are a planning item for the Wedded Advisor.
